invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Every span MUST have a non-empty name, a start timestamp, and an end timestamp in that causal order.
A span CANNOT be ended twice; a second end call SHALL be a no-op with a recorded internal warning.
The tracer MUST honor W3C Trace Context headers (traceparent, tracestate) on both inject and extract without mutation of unknown tracestate vendor entries.
Recording an exception MUST set the span status code to ERROR unless the caller explicitly overrides with OK.
Attribute values MUST be one of: string, bool, int, float, or a homogeneous sequence of those types; nested structures are FORBIDDEN.
The tracer SHALL NEVER block the caller waiting for exporter acknowledgement; export is asynchronous.
